hero.title: Biomedical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: Biomedical engineering is the fusion of engineering, biology, medicine and technology to create health care related equipment and systems. If you are a student interested in medical devices, artificial organs, rehabilitation technology, diagnostic equipment and healthcare innovation, this could be the field for you. **Biomedical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** is a study option worth researching for students interested in combining engineering principles with healthcare technology.

overview: Important to prospective students: The University of Mauritius has not listed a specific Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering in its published undergraduate program list for the 2026–2027 academic year. It also has related programs such as Pharmaceutical Biotechnology, Applied Biochemistry, Mechatronics Engineering and Electrical and Electronic Engineering. They are alternative study paths, not equal qualifications in Biomedical Engineering. Students planning to **Study Biomedical Engineering in Mauritius** should understand the difference between a dedicated biomedical engineering degree and related science or engineering qualifications.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Biomedical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Biomedical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Biomedical Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
